description: A worktree holds uncommitted work and the session that was writing in it is not in `## Sessions` any more. Nobody asked about trees. The audit reports per tree and this is a fact about owners, so until the join it was found by nobody — and a checked fact belongs on `Verified`, not only in a reply.

graders.name: it asks the audit rather than guessing
the reply names the tree whose writer is gone
and says the work in it is uncommitted
the fact lands on the Verified line, where a checked fact belongs
Log times are this move's clock reads
